sinks._comment: Single-column mode (no 'columns' array) with a JSON-shaped target column: 'mode':'tag_map' adds a server-side 'fields Map(String, String) MATERIALIZED JSONExtract(doc, ...)' projection over 'target_column' ('doc' here instead of the default 'payload'). 'encoding':'json' makes the column itself hold JSON text so the projection is well-formed; it defaults to 'json' automatically whenever 'mode' isn't 'raw_text', so it could also be omitted here.
